texts.text: Every resource below was created for one reason — to help therapists and clinicians stop surviving their practice and start running it like a Boss. FIND WHERE YOU ARE AND START THERE.
The 4-Step Blueprint to Building a Profitable Private Practice
Because starting a practice shouldn’t feel confusing, overwhelming, or lonely.
Most therapists were never taught how to actually build a profitable, sustainable practice—we were taught how to help people, not run a business.

This FREE masterclass breaks it all down for you. You’ll learn a simple 4-step framework to start or grow your private practice with more confidence and less chaos. No guesswork. No overwhelm. No piecing together random advice.
If you want clear direction, a smarter not harder strategy, and a roadmap that helps you avoid the common pitfalls new practice owners face, this masterclass is your first step.
Want to know if you should take insurance or accept superbills in your practice?
Just starting your practice or want to make sure you starter on the right path?
Grab my must have profitable practice planner now.
What Would Your Practice Look Like If You Actually Charged What You're Worth?
Most therapists have never done this math. They fill their schedule and hope the numbers work out at the end of the month. That's not a strategy — that's survival mode.

Use this calculator to see exactly what your practice could generate based on your session rate and caseload. Then ask yourself the real question: are you charging what your expertise actually deserves?
Tip: Try running the numbers at your current rate — then run them again at $175 or $200 per session. That difference is what strategy creates.
Find out precisely how much you can earn. Customize your sessions and rate below.
Disclaimer: This calculator illustrates potential outcomes. Results depend on your market, niche, and implementation. Nothing is guaranteed.

I am grateful to work with Yvette as she helped me become further independent with my private practice. Yvette is been helpful every step of the way by providing resources for my internal dilemmas, and providing support with video play backs, and setting goals to help hold me accountable.
I’m here to help therapists turn their clinical skills into sustainable, aligned businesses—without burning out or breaking their values.

I grew from solo practitioner to group practice owner, made every mistake imaginable, navigated insurance chaos, scaled into a W2 agency, and learned how to lead a practice that supports both clients and clinicians. Today, I run a thriving group practice, serve as a clinical supervisor, and build businesses that create freedom, flexibility, and stability—for me and for the therapists I support.
Now, through Boss Clinician , I teach therapists how to become CEOs of their clinical expertise and build practices that actually support their lives.
Get started today before this once in a lifetime opportunity expires.
